pgmpy documentation

Summary
pgmpy is a Python library for causal inference and probabilistic graphical models.
These docs explain structure learning, parameter estimation, inference, causal identification/estimation,
metrics, datasets, and simulation.

Key pages
/started/quickstart - task-oriented code examples to get started
/examples - Jupyter notebook examples organized by topic
/documentation - documentation landing page
/reference - API reference landing page
/guides/causal_discovery - structure learning and causal discovery
/guides/parameter_estimation - estimating CPDs for known structures
/guides/probabilistic_inference - exact and approximate inference
/guides/causal_identification - backdoor/frontdoor identification
/guides/causal_estimation - estimating causal effects
/guides/metrics - evaluation metrics
/guides/datasets - built-in datasets
/guides/example_models - pre-built Bayesian Networks
/guides/simulations - sampling and synthetic data
/guides/io - import/export formats
/guides/custom_model - defining models and CPDs
/guides/plotting - plotting and visualization options
/guides/extensibility - extension templates for datasets, models, metrics, and algorithms
